questions.question_text: Which of the following correctly describes ecological fallacy

options.text: Erroneous result due to selecting smaller groups instead of larger groups
Erroneous result due to selecting larger groups instead of smaller groups
Ascribing the characteristics of a group to all individuals in that group
Failure to examine temporal relationships between exposures and outcomes

correct_answer.text: Ascribing the characteristics of a group to all individuals in that group
